body.statement: Fix \(I\in\mathfrak J_{q,k}\), a block \(c\in C\), and one external-parent context. The raw equality supports partition \(R_c\) into at most \(q^2\) cliques of \(Primal\). Consequently \(|R_c|\le q^2(k+1)=s\), without adding an explicit normalization row.
body.justification: The lemma converts the supplied scalar width into a bound on each explicit response block, which is the missing finite-domain parameter.
body.gap: Shridharan--Iyengar note the fixed-context partition and implied normalization but do not combine it with scalar primal width to bound canonical block size.
body.consumer: The support enumerator obtains a finite \(2^s\) local domain without reconstructing any unlisted canonical state.
